decisions.reason: The award is an early positive signal and, as a close extension of the firm's core yogurt range in a growing organic dairy market, it is a low-cost option worth keeping while demand continues to develop.
Its home-page promotion suggests active support, and as an incremental cheese variant the firm is likely to keep this relatively inexpensive market option open until sales become clearer.
